dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped rings with high-contrast light perimeters surrounding darker interior cores. Edge perimeters show fine-grained serration and non-uniform thickness, most prominent along the central dorsal-lateral axis.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to medium density of solid, high-intensity light pixels appearing as punctate blobs without internal gradients, concentrated primarily in the posterior lateral region and along the lower ventral-lateral margins.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Three prominent macro-annuli located in the upper mid-section form an obtuse scalene triangle, while a sequence of four smaller high-intensity blobs along the posterior flank forms a curvilinear path following the body's lower contour.
